summary: Comprehensive architecture and implementation plan for Lennder (BorrowBox Campus Rental MVP), covering student onboarding with AI Student ID & Reg Number verification, hybrid Managed Stock Points + P2P Student Listings, dual security (refundable deposit + auto-purging collateral photo), QR/OTP handover & return workflows, Admin/Attendant Operations Console, and Cloud SQL PostgreSQL + Drizzle ORM backend.
